summary: NewcelX Ltd., a Zurich-domiciled pharmaceutical preparer formerly NLS Pharmaceutics, filed a Form 6-K, the foreign-private-issuer equivalent of a US current report, carrying its interim report for the period ended June 30, 2026. The exhibit metadata discloses no transaction; it references only historical financing mechanics, including July 2026 PIPE offering elements, April 2026 PIPE warrants and preferred participation certificates, legacy and placement-agent warrants, stock options, and an equity-line-of-credit agreement. No special-situation event, stake, price, premium, advisor, board recommendation, structural overhang, or regulatory clock is stated. Watch for future 6-K disclosures on financing dilution and warrant overhang.
